# Generated by scripts/gen_sol_lshud.py; edit scripts/sol_map_modes_source.py.

# Location scope. SOL amount: flat + (1 + percent) * annual funds per thousand.
sol_map_living_standard_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sol_location_sol }
		value = var:sol_location_sol
	}
}

# Positive fallback until the first positive world average: 6 annual units.
sol_map_living_standard_fallback = { value = 6 }
sol_map_living_standard_reference = {
	value = sol_map_living_standard_fallback
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sol_ls_world_sol global_var:sol_ls_world_sol > 0 }
		value = global_var:sol_ls_world_sol
	}
}

# Normalized comparisons affect colors/wording only, never the displayed amount.
sol_map_living_standard_relative_value = { value = sol_map_living_standard_value divide = sol_map_living_standard_reference }
sol_map_living_standard_below_factor = { value = sol_map_living_standard_relative_value min = 0 max = 1 }
sol_map_living_standard_above_factor = { value = sol_map_living_standard_relative_value subtract = 1 divide = 2 min = 0 max = 1 }

# Location scope. Raw purchasing power - 1. Do not read sol_location_final_demand_scale or modifier size.
sol_map_purchasing_power_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sol_location_liquid_funds has_variable = sol_location_base_total_spending var:sol_location_base_total_spending > 0 }
		value = var:sol_location_liquid_funds
		divide = var:sol_location_base_total_spending
		subtract = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The cached percentile already maps best -> 1 and worst -> 0.
sol_map_rank_color_factor = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sol_ls_rank has_variable = sol_ls_percentile }
		value = var:sol_ls_percentile
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sol_ls_rank_count global_var:sol_ls_rank_count = 1 } value = 1 }
		min = 0
		max = 1
	}
}
